title.en: Dialogue: Choose the one with religion

intro.en: Bilal wants to get married and talks to his mother. She reminds him that real happiness comes from religion, not only money or beauty. Notice «ذاتُ مالٍ» (one who has wealth) and «ذاتُ الدِّين» (one who has religion).
intro.ur: Bilal shaadi karna chahta hai aur apni walida se baat karta hai. Walida samjhati hain ke asal khushi deen se milti hai, sirf maal ya husn se nahin. Dhyan dein: «ذاتُ مالٍ» (maal wali) aur «ذاتُ الدِّين» (deen wali).
intro.ar: يُريدُ بِلالٌ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ فَيَتَحَدَّثُ إِلى أُمِّهِ، فَتُذَكِّرُهُ أَنَّ السَّعادَةَ الحَقيقِيَّةَ في الدِّينِ لا في المالِ وَالجَمالِ فَقَطْ. لاحِظْ «ذاتُ مالٍ» أَيْ صاحِبَةُ المالِ، وَ«ذاتُ الدِّينِ» أَيْ صاحِبَةُ الدِّينِ.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتَ قَلِقٌ يا وَلَدي، ماذا بِكَ؟!
dialogue.tr: anta qaliqun yā waladī, mādhā bika?
dialogue.en: You are worried, my son. What is wrong with you?
dialogue.ur: Aap pareshan hain mere bete, kya hua?

dialogue.ar: أُرِيدُ الزَّواجَ يا أُمّي، وَلا أَجِدُ الفَتاةَ المُناسِبَةَ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu z-zawāja yā ummī, wa lā ajidu l-fatāta l-munāsibah
dialogue.en: I want to marry, mother, but I cannot find the suitable girl.
dialogue.ur: Ammi, main shaadi karna chahta hoon magar munasib ladki nahin milti.

dialogue.ar: هذِهِ لَيْسَتْ مُشْكِلَةً. هُناكَ فَتَياتٌ كَثِيراتٌ مُناسِباتٌ لِلزَّواجِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi laysat mushkilah. hunāka fatayātun kathīrātun munāsibātun liz-zawāj
dialogue.en: This is not a problem. There are many girls suitable for marriage.
dialogue.ur: Ye masla nahin. Shaadi ke liye bohat si munasib ladkiyan hain.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْرِفينَ واحِدَةً مُناسِبَةً؟
dialogue.tr: hal taʿrifīna wāḥidatan munāsibah?
dialogue.en: Do you know a suitable one?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap koi munasib ladki jaanti hain?

dialogue.ar: فاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ صالِح.
dialogue.tr: Fāṭimatu bnatu Ṣāliḥ
dialogue.en: Fatima, daughter of Salih.
dialogue.ur: Fatima, Salih ki beti.

dialogue.ar: هذِهِ غَيْرُ مُناسِبَةٍ! إِنَّها فَقيرَةٌ، لا مالَ لَها.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi ghayru munāsibah! innahā faqīrah, lā māla lahā
dialogue.en: She is not suitable! She is poor, she has no money.
dialogue.ur: Ye munasib nahin! Wo gareeb hai, uske paas maal nahin.

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ في زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ اللهِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā raʾyuka fī Zaynaba bnti ʿAbdillāh?
dialogue.en: What is your opinion of Zaynab, daughter of Abdullah?
dialogue.ur: Zainab binte Abdullah ke baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هِيَ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ غَنِيَّةٍ، وَلكِنِّي سَمِعْتُ أَنَّها غَيْرُ جَميلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hiya min usratin ghaniyyah, wa lākinnī samiʿtu annahā ghayru jamīlah
dialogue.en: Yes, she is from a rich family, but I heard she is not beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Haan, wo ameer khandan se hai, lekin maine suna hai ke wo khoobsurat nahin.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ هُدى بِنْتُ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka Hudā bntu ʿAbdil-ʿAzīz
dialogue.en: There is Huda, daughter of Abdul Aziz.
dialogue.ur: Huda binte Abdul Aziz bhi hain.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّها ذاتُ مالٍ وَجَمالٍ، وَلكِنِّي أُرِيدُ الحَسَبَ وَالنَّسَبَ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu annahā dhātu mālin wa jamāl, wa lākinnī urīdu l-ḥasaba wan-nasab
dialogue.en: I heard she has wealth and beauty, but I want good standing and lineage.
dialogue.ur: Maine suna wo maal aur husn wali hai, lekin main hasab aur nasab chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: تُرِيدُ المالَ وَالجَمالَ وَالحَسَبَ وَالنَّسَبَ. هذا لا يُحَقِّقُ السَّعادَةَ!
dialogue.tr: turīdu l-māla wal-jamāla wal-ḥasaba wan-nasab. hādhā lā yuḥaqqiqu s-saʿādah
dialogue.en: You want wealth, beauty, standing and lineage. This does not bring happiness!
dialogue.ur: Aap maal, husn, hasab aur nasab chahte hain. Ye khushi nahin deta!

dialogue.ar: ما الَّذي يُحَقِّقُ السَّعادَةَ إِذَنْ؟!
dialogue.tr: mā lladhī yuḥaqqiqu s-saʿādata idhan?
dialogue.en: What brings happiness then?
dialogue.ur: To phir khushi kis cheez se milti hai?

dialogue.ar: إِذا أَرَدْتَ السَّعادَةَ فَعَلَيْكَ بِذاتِ الدِّينِ.
dialogue.tr: idhā aradta s-saʿādah faʿalayka bidhāti d-dīn
dialogue.en: If you want happiness, then choose the one with religion.
dialogue.ur: Agar khushi chahte ho to deen wali ko chuno.

dialogue.ar: ذاتُ الدِّينِ. أَحْسَنْتِ يا أُمّي. هذا قَوْلُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ: «فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ الدِّينِ، تَرِبَتْ يَداكَ».
dialogue.tr: dhātu d-dīn. aḥsanti yā ummī. hādhā qawlu r-rasūli ﷺ: «faẓfar bidhāti d-dīn, taribat yadāk»
dialogue.en: Having religion. Well said, mother. This is the Messenger's ﷺ saying: «Win the one with religion, may your hands be dusty.»
dialogue.ur: Deen wali. Shabash ammi. Ye Rasool ﷺ ka farmaan hai: «deen wali ko hasil karo, tumhare haath khaak aalood hon (yani kamyab raho).»

q.en: What does the mother say makes a person happy?
q.ur: Walida ke mutabiq khushi kis cheez se milti hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي تَقولُ الأُمُّ إِنَّهُ يُسْعِدُ الإِنْسانَ؟

q.en: Which word is the opposite of «جَمِيل» (beautiful)?
q.ur: «جَمِيل» ka ulta kaun sa lafz hai?
Hadees ke alfaz mukammal karein: «فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ ...»

title.en: Sounds: the long و and the soft و

intro.en: Two sounds of و. Waw of madd (long ُـو) follows a damma and is stretched, like دُور (dūr). Waw of liin (soft َـوْ) follows a fatha and has sukun, like حَوْل (ḥawl). Listen and repeat the Qur'an verses.
intro.ur: و ki do awaazein. Waaw-e-madd (ُـو) damma ke baad aati hai aur lambi parhi jati hai, jaise دُور (door). Waaw-e-leen (َـوْ) fatha ke baad aati hai aur us par sukoon hota hai, jaise حَوْل (hawl). Qur'an ki aayaat sunein aur dohraein.
intro.ar: لِلْواوِ صَوْتانِ: واوُ المَدِّ تَأْتي بَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ وَتُمَدُّ، مِثْلَ دُور، وَواوُ اللِّينِ تَأْتي بَعْدَ الفَتْحَةِ وَتَكونُ ساكِنَةً، مِثْلَ حَوْل. اِسْتَمِعْ وَرَدِّدِ الآياتِ.

dialogue.ar: وَالطُّورِ ﴿١﴾ وَكِتابٍ مَسْطُورٍ ﴿٢﴾ فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ ﴿٣﴾
dialogue.tr: waṭ-ṭūr, wa kitābin masṭūr, fī raqqin manshūr
dialogue.en: By the Mount, and a Book inscribed, on an unrolled scroll. (At-Tur 1-3)
dialogue.ur: Qasam hai Toor ki, aur likhi hui kitaab ki, khuli hui jhilli mein. (At-Toor 1-3)

dialogue.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا اللهَ وَالرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
dialogue.tr: wa aṭīʿū llāha war-rasūla laʿallakum turḥamūn
dialogue.en: And obey Allah and the Messenger so that you may receive mercy. (Aal Imran 132)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo taake tum par raham kiya jaye. (Aal Imran 132)

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّماءِ ذاتِ البُرُوجِ ﴿١﴾ وَاليَوْمِ المَوْعُودِ ﴿٢﴾
dialogue.tr: was-samāʾi dhātil-burūj, wal-yawmil-mawʿūd
dialogue.en: By the sky containing great stars, and by the promised Day. (Al-Buruj 1-2)
dialogue.ur: Qasam hai burjon wale aasman ki, aur wada kiye hue din ki. (Al-Burooj 1-2)

dialogue.ar: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ
dialogue.tr: alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin wa āmanahum min khawf
dialogue.en: Who fed them against hunger and secured them from fear. (Quraysh 4)
dialogue.ur: Jis ne unhein bhook mein khilaya aur khauf se amaan di. (Quraish 4)

q.en: The waw of madd comes after which vowel?
q.ur: Waaw-e-madd kis harkat ke baad aata hai?
q.ar: بَعْدَ أَيِّ حَرَكَةٍ تَأْتي واوُ المَدِّ؟

q.en: Which word has the waw of madd?

intro.en: Every noun is masculine (مُذَكَّر) or feminine (مُؤَنَّث). A common sign of the feminine is the round ta (ـة), like طَبِيب (doctor, m.) and طَبِيبَة (doctor, f.).
intro.ur: Har ism muzakkar (مُذَكَّر) ya muannas (مُؤَنَّث) hota hai. Muannas ki aam nishani gol ta (ـة) hai, jaise طَبِيب (doctor, mard) aur طَبِيبَة (doctor, aurat).
intro.ar: كُلُّ اسْمٍ إِمّا مُذَكَّرٌ وَإِمّا مُؤَنَّثٌ. وَمِنْ عَلاماتِ المُؤَنَّثِ الشّائِعَةِ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة)، مِثْلَ: طَبيب (مُذَكَّرٌ) وَطَبيبَة (مُؤَنَّثٌ).

q.en: What is a common sign of the feminine?
q.ur: Muannas ki aam nishani kya hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur Bolna: Shaadi ke baare mein

intro.en: A listening exercise about two friends, Abdullah and Ahmad, and then speaking practice with a classmate about marriage in your country. The audio is on the slide; the questions use words you already know.
intro.ur: Do doston, Abdullah aur Ahmad, ke baare mein sunne ki mashq, phir apne sathi ke saath shaadi ke baare mein guftagu. Audio slide par maujood hai; sawaal aise alfaz mein hain jo aap jaante hain.
intro.ar: تَمْرينُ اسْتِماعٍ عَنْ صَديقَيْنِ هُما عَبْدُ اللهِ وَأَحْمَدُ، ثُمَّ تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ الزَّواجِ في بَلَدِكَ. الصَّوْتُ مَوْجودٌ في الشَّريحَةِ، وَالأَسْئِلَةُ بِكَلِماتٍ تَعْرِفُها.

q.en: How do you ask «When does a young man marry in your country?»
q.ur: «Aap ke mulk mein naujawan kab shaadi karta hai?» kaise poochenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ: مَتى يَتَزَوَّجُ الشّابُّ في بَلَدِكَ؟

q.ur: «ذاتُ دِين» kaisi ladki ko kehte hain?
Kaun sa lafz «kaise» ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الطَّريقَةِ؟

title.en: Reading: Do problems happen between spouses?
title.ur: Parhna: Kya miyan biwi mein masle hote hain?

intro.en: A short reading about married life. It is full of good things, but small problems can appear, and the way to success is dialogue. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Shadi-shuda zindagi ke baare mein ek mukhtasar matn. Is mein bohat khair hai, lekin kabhi masle bhi aate hain, aur kamyabi ka raasta baat cheet hai. Aaram se, jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ قَصيرٌ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ: هِيَ مَليئَةٌ بِالخَيْرِ، وَقَدْ تَظْهَرُ فيها مُشْكِلاتٌ صَغيرَةٌ، وَطَريقُ النَّجاحِ هُوَ الحِوارُ. اِقْرَأْ ببُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: فِي الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ لِلزَّوْجِ وَلِلزَّوْجَةِ وَلِلأَوْلادِ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ḥayāti z-zawjiyyati khayrun kathīrun liz-zawji waliz-zawjati walil-awlād
dialogue.en: In married life there is much good for the husband, the wife and the children.
dialogue.ur: Shadi-shuda zindagi mein shauhar, biwi aur bachon ke liye bohat khair hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ ذلِكَ تَظْهَرُ، أَحْيانًا، بَعْضُ المُشْكِلاتِ فِي حَياةِ الزَّوْجَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: wa maʿa dhālika taẓharu, aḥyānan, baʿḍu l-mushkilāt fī ḥayāti z-zawjayn
dialogue.en: Even so, some problems sometimes appear in the life of the couple.
dialogue.ur: Phir bhi kabhi kabhi miyan biwi ki zindagi mein kuch masle samne aate hain.

dialogue.ar: يَعْتَقِدُ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الشَّبابِ أَنَّ الحَياةَ الزَّوْجِيَّةَ بِلا مُشْكِلاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿtaqidu kathīrun mina sh-shabābi anna l-ḥayāta z-zawjiyyata bilā mushkilāt
dialogue.en: Many young people believe that married life is without problems.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se naujawan samajhte hain ke shadi-shuda zindagi masloon se khaali hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: عَلَى الشَّبابِ أَنْ يَعْرِفُوا أَنَّ الحَياةَ الزَّوْجِيَّةَ رِحْلَةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ، وَأَنَّ السَّبِيلَ إِلَى النَّجاحِ فِي الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ هُوَ الحِوارُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿalā sh-shabābi an yaʿrifū anna l-ḥayāta z-zawjiyyata riḥlatun ṭawīlah, wa anna s-sabīla ilā n-najāḥi huwa l-ḥiwār
dialogue.en: Young people must know that married life is a long journey, and the way to success is dialogue.
dialogue.ur: Naujawanon ko jaan lena chahiye ke shadi-shuda zindagi lamba safar hai aur kamyabi ka raasta baat cheet hai.

dialogue.ar: يَعُودُ السَّبَبُ إِلَى وُجُودِ اخْتِلافاتٍ كَثِيرَةٍ بَيْنَ شَخْصِيَّةِ الرَّجُلِ وَشَخْصِيَّةِ المَرْأَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿūdu s-sababu ilā wujūdi ikhtilāfātin kathīrah bayna shakhṣiyyati r-rajuli wa shakhṣiyyati l-marʾah
dialogue.en: The cause goes back to many differences between the man's personality and the woman's.
dialogue.ur: Wajah mard aur aurat ki shakhsiyat mein bohat se farq hain.

dialogue.ar: فَالرَّجُلُ يُحِبُّ أَشْياءَ لا تُحِبُّها المَرْأَةُ، وَالمَرْأَةُ تُحِبُّ أَشْياءَ لا يُحِبُّها الرَّجُلُ.
dialogue.tr: far-rajulu yuḥibbu ashyāʾa lā tuḥibbuhā l-marʾah, wal-marʾatu tuḥibbu ashyāʾa lā yuḥibbuhā r-rajul
dialogue.en: The man likes things the woman does not like, and the woman likes things the man does not like.
dialogue.ur: Mard woh cheezein pasand karta hai jo aurat pasand nahin karti, aur aurat woh jo mard pasand nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: يَشْكُو الزَّوْجُ فَيَقُولُ: زَوْجَتِي لا تَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيَّ، وَتَتَكَلَّمُ مَعَ صَدِيقاتِها فِي الهاتِفِ كَثِيرًا.
dialogue.tr: yashkū z-zawju fayaqūl: zawjatī lā tastamiʿu ilayy, wa tatakallamu maʿa ṣadīqātihā fil-hātifi kathīrā
dialogue.en: The husband complains and says: My wife does not listen to me and talks to her friends on the phone a lot.
dialogue.ur: Shauhar shikayat karta hai: meri biwi meri baat nahin sunti aur saheliyon se phone par bohat baatein karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَشْكُو الزَّوْجَةُ فَتَقُولُ: زَوْجِي يَتَكَلَّمُ طُولَ الوَقْتِ فِي السِّياسَةِ وَالرِّياضَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa tashkū z-zawjatu fataqūl: zawjī yatakallamu ṭūla l-waqti fis-siyāsati war-riyāḍah
dialogue.en: The wife complains and says: My husband talks all the time about politics and sport.
dialogue.ur: Biwi shikayat karti hai: mere shauhar har waqt siyasat aur khel ki baatein karte hain.

q.en: According to the text, married life is…

options: full of good, but problems may appear
options_ar: مَليئَةٌ بِالخَيْرِ وَقَدْ تَظْهَرُ فيها مُشْكِلاتٌ

q.en: What should young people know about married life?
q.ur: Naujawanon ko shadi ke baare mein kya maloom hona chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ الشَّبابُ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ؟

q.en: What is the way to success in married life?
q.ar: ما طَريقُ النَّجاحِ في الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ؟

intro.en: A sentence is of two kinds. A nominal sentence (جُمْلَة اسْمِيَّة) starts with a noun, like «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ» (the school is big). A verbal sentence (جُمْلَة فِعْلِيَّة) starts with a verb, like «أُرِيدُ الزَّواجَ» (I want marriage).
intro.ur: Jumle ki do qismein hain. Jumla ismiyya (جُمْلَة اسْمِيَّة) ism se shuru hota hai, jaise «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ» (school bara hai). Jumla fi'liyya (جُمْلَة فِعْلِيَّة) fe'l se shuru hota hai, jaise «أُرِيدُ الزَّواجَ» (main shadi chahta hoon).
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ نَوْعانِ: جُمْلَةٌ اسْمِيَّةٌ تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ، مِثْلَ «المَدْرَسَةُ كَبيرَةٌ»، وَجُمْلَةٌ فِعْلِيَّةٌ تَبْدَأُ بِفِعْلٍ، مِثْلَ «أُريدُ الزَّواجَ».

vocab.ur: wo maal aur husn chahta hai

q.ur: Jumla ismiyya kis se shuru hota hai?
Jumla fi'liyya kis se shuru hota hai?
«ذَهَبَ الطّالِبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ» kaisa jumla hai?

title.en: Dialogue: Staying up outside the home
title.ur: Mukaalma: Ghar se bahar raat jaagna

intro.en: Naser tells his friend Faisal that he wants to leave his wife. Faisal asks why and gives good advice. Notice the useful phrases: «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ» and «بِإِذْنِ اللهِ».
intro.ur: Nasir apne dost Faisal ko batata hai ke wo apni biwi ko chhodna chahta hai. Faisal wajah poochta hai aur achi nasihat karta hai. Mufeed jumle: «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ» aur «بِإِذْنِ اللهِ».
intro.ar: يُخْبِرُ ناصِرٌ صَديقَهُ فَيْصَلاً أَنَّهُ يُريدُ تَرْكَ زَوْجَتِهِ، فَيَسْأَلُهُ فَيْصَلٌ عَنِ السَّبَبِ وَيَنْصَحُهُ. لاحِظْ عِبارَتَيْنِ مُفيدَتَيْنِ: «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ» وَ«بِإِذْنِ اللهِ».

dialogue.ar: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتْرُكَ زَوْجَتِي.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an atruka zawjatī
dialogue.en: I want to leave my wife.
dialogue.ur: Main apni biwi ko chhodna chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ. ماذا هُناكَ؟!
dialogue.tr: lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. mādhā hunāk?
dialogue.en: There is no power or strength except with Allah. What is going on?
dialogue.ur: Allah ke siwa na koi taaqat hai na quwwat. Kya hua?

dialogue.ar: لا أُحِبُّها.
dialogue.tr: lā uḥibbuhā
dialogue.en: I do not love her.
dialogue.ur: Main usse mohabbat nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: لا تُحِبُّها؟! كَيْفَ عِشْتَ مَعَها كُلَّ هذِهِ السَّنَواتِ؟!
dialogue.tr: lā tuḥibbuhā?! kayfa ʿishta maʿahā kulla hādhihi s-sanawāt?
dialogue.en: You do not love her?! How did you live with her all these years?
dialogue.ur: Tum usse mohabbat nahin karte?! Itne saalon tak uske saath kaise rahe?

dialogue.ar: لا أَدْرِي... لا أُحِبُّها.
dialogue.tr: lā adrī... lā uḥibbuhā
dialogue.en: I do not know... I do not love her.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe nahin pata... main usse mohabbat nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: كُنْتَ تَقُولُ دائِمًا: إِنَّها زَوْجَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَمُؤَدَّبَةٌ وَمُطِيعَةٌ. ماذا حَدَثَ؟
dialogue.tr: kunta taqūlu dāʾiman: innahā zawjatun ṭayyibatun wa muʾaddabatun wa muṭīʿah. mādhā ḥadath?
dialogue.en: You always used to say: she is a kind, well-mannered and obedient wife. What happened?
dialogue.ur: Tum hamesha kehte the: wo achi, bā-adab aur farmanbardar biwi hai. Kya hua?

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ أُحِبُّها فِعْلًا، وَلكِنَّها تَغَيَّرَتْ كَثِيرًا.
dialogue.tr: kuntu uḥibbuhā fiʿlan, wa lākinnahā taghayyarat kathīrā
dialogue.en: I really did love her, but she has changed a lot.
dialogue.ur: Main waqai usse mohabbat karta tha, lekin wo bohat badal gayi.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَتْ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa taghayyarat?
dialogue.en: How did she change?
dialogue.ur: Wo kaise badli?

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَتْ مُهْمِلَةً، لا تَهْتَمُّ بِي، وَلا بِالبَيْتِ. تَهْتَمُّ بِنَفْسِها وَبِصَدِيقاتِها فَقَطْ.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥat muhmilah, lā tahtammu bī, wa lā bil-bayt. tahtammu binafsihā wa biṣadīqātihā faqaṭ
dialogue.en: She became careless, she does not care about me or the house. She cares only about herself and her friends.
dialogue.ur: Wo laparwah ho gayi hai, na meri parwah karti hai na ghar ki. Sirf apna aur saheliyon ka khayal rakhti hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَكَلَّمْتَ مَعَها فِي هذا الأَمْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal takallamta maʿahā fī hādhā l-amr?
dialogue.en: Did you talk to her about this matter?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum ne is baare mein us se baat ki?

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْتُ مَعَها كَثِيرًا، وَلكِنَّها عَنِيدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: takallamtu maʿahā kathīrā, wa lākinnahā ʿanīdah
dialogue.en: I talked to her a lot, but she is stubborn.
dialogue.ur: Maine bohat baat ki, lekin wo ziddi hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَغَيَّرْتَ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taghayyarta anta?
dialogue.en: Have you changed?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum badle ho?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَصْبَحْتُ أَسْهَرُ كَثِيرًا خارِجَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, aṣbaḥtu asharu kathīran khārija l-bayt
dialogue.en: Yes, I have started staying up a lot outside the home.
dialogue.ur: Haan, main ghar se bahar bohat raat jaagne laga hoon.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ يَكُونُ هذا هُوَ السَّبَبَ. لا تَسْهَرْ خارِجَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: qad yakūnu hādhā huwa s-sabab. lā tashar khārija l-bayt
dialogue.en: This may be the reason. Do not stay up outside the home.
dialogue.ur: Shayad yehi wajah ho. Ghar se bahar raat mat jaago.

dialogue.ar: سَأَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: sa-afʿalu dhālik
dialogue.en: I will do that.
dialogue.ur: Main aisa hi karunga.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ سَتَهْتَمُّ زَوْجَتُكَ بِكَ وَبِبَيْتِها، بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: idhan satahtammu zawjatuka bika wa bibaytihā, bi-idhnillāh
dialogue.en: Then your wife will care for you and her home, God willing.
dialogue.ur: To phir tumhari biwi tumhari aur apne ghar ki parwah karegi, Allah ke hukm se.

vocab.ur: Allah aap ko jazaye khair de
Allah ka shukar hai aap salamat hain

vocab.tr: innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn
vocab.en: we belong to Allah and to Him we return
vocab.ur: hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautne wale hain

options: He wants to leave his wife
He wants to buy a car

q.ur: Nasir ne kya karna shuru kar diya tha?

options: staying up late outside the home
Do not stay up outside the home

q.en: What does Faisal say his wife will do then?
q.ur: Faisal ke mutabiq tab biwi kya karegi?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ فَيْصَلٌ إِنَّ زَوْجَتَهُ سَتَفْعَلُ حينَئِذٍ؟

options: care for him and her home

intro.en: A silent ta (تْ) is added to the end of a past verb when the doer is feminine. Example: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» (a husband came) becomes «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ» (a wife came). The verb changes, the rest stays.
intro.ur: Jab fa'il muannas ho to maazi fe'l ke aakhir mein sakin ta (تْ) lagti hai. Misaal: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» (shauhar aaya) se «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ» (biwi aayi). Sirf fe'l badalta hai, baqi waisa hi rehta hai.
intro.ar: نُضيفُ تاءً ساكِنَةً (تْ) إِلى آخِرِ الفِعْلِ الماضي إِذا كانَ الفاعِلُ مُؤَنَّثاً. مِثالٌ: «جاءَ زَوْجٌ» تَصيرُ «جاءَتْ زَوْجَةٌ». يَتَغَيَّرُ الفِعْلُ وَيَبْقى الباقي.

q.en: The silent ta (تْ) is added to…
q.ur: Saakin ta kis ke saath lagti hai?

q.en: Which verb has the silent ta?
q.ur: Kis fe'l mein saakin ta hai?
«فَحَصَتْ طَبِيبَةُ القَلْبِ المَرِيضَةَ» Kis ne mo'ayna kiya?
q.ar: «فَحَصَتْ طَبِيبَةُ القَلْبِ المَرِيضَةَ». مَنِ الَّتي فَحَصَتْ؟

q.en: «قَرَأَتِ البِنْتُ الصَّحِيفَةَ». The ta tells us the reader is…
q.ur: Ta bata rahi hai parhne wala kaun hai:
q.ar: «قَرَأَتِ البِنْتُ الصَّحيفَةَ». التّاءُ تَدُلُّنا عَلى أَنَّ القارِئَ…

title.en: Listening and speaking about the family
title.ur: Sunna aur Bolna: Khandan ke baare mein

intro.en: A listening text about a man's family (children, wife, relatives), then speaking practice about husbands and wives at home. The questions use family words: sons, daughters, paternal aunt (عَمَّة) and maternal aunt (خالَة).
intro.ur: Ek shakhs ke khandan (bachon, biwi, rishtedaron) ke baare mein sunne ka matn, phir ghar mein miyan biwi ke baare mein guftagu. Sawaal khandan ke alfaz par hain: bete, betiyan, phuphi (عَمَّة) aur khala (خالَة).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلاسْتِماعِ عَنْ أُسْرَةِ رَجُلٍ (أَبْناءٌ وَزَوْجَةٌ وَأَقارِبُ)، ثُمَّ تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ عَنِ الأَزْواجِ في البَيْتِ. الأَسْئِلَةُ بِكَلِماتِ الأُسْرَةِ: أَبْناء، بَنات، عَمَّة (أُخْتُ الأَبِ)، خالَة (أُخْتُ الأُمِّ).

options: he stays up outside the home

title.en: Reading: The family, past and present

intro.en: A reading about how the family has changed. In the past the big family lived in one house; today the small family (husband, wife and children) is common. Before reading, think: is your family big or small?
intro.ur: Is matn mein dekhein ke khandan kaise badla. Pehle bara khandan ek ghar mein rehta tha; aaj chhota khandan (shauhar, biwi, bachche) aam hai. Parhne se pehle sochein: aap ka khandan bara hai ya chhota?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ تَغَيُّرِ الأُسْرَةِ: كانَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الكَبيرَةُ تَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ واحِدٍ، وَاليَوْمَ شاعَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الصَّغيرَةُ (الزَّوْجُ وَالزَّوْجَةُ وَالأَوْلادُ). فَكِّرْ قَبْلَ القِراءَةِ: هَلْ أُسْرَتُكَ كَبيرَةٌ أَمْ صَغيرَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: يَخْتَلِفُ نِظامُ الأُسْرَةِ الآنَ عَنْ نِظامِ الأُسْرَةِ فِي الماضِي.
dialogue.tr: yakhtalifu niẓāmu l-usrati l-āna ʿan niẓāmi l-usrati fil-māḍī
dialogue.en: The family system now differs from the family system in the past.
dialogue.ur: Aaj ka khandani nizaam maazi ke nizaam se mukhtalif hai.

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الكَبِيرَةُ تَسْكُنُ فِي بَيْتٍ واحِدٍ كَبِيرٍ، يَضُمُّ جَمِيعَ أَفْرادِها.
dialogue.tr: kānati l-usratu l-kabīrah taskunu fī baytin wāḥidin kabīr, yaḍummu jamīʿa afrādihā
dialogue.en: The big family used to live in one big house that included all its members.
dialogue.ur: Bara khandan ek bare ghar mein rehta tha jis mein sab afraad hote the.

dialogue.ar: اخْتَفَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الكَبِيرَةُ، وَظَهَرَتِ الأُسْرَةُ الصَّغِيرَةُ، الَّتِي تَضُمُّ الزَّوْجَ وَالزَّوْجَةَ وَالوَلَدَ، أَوِ الوَلَدَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: ikhtafati l-usratu l-kabīrah, wa ẓaharati l-usratu ṣ-ṣaghīrah, allatī taḍummu z-zawja waz-zawjata wal-walad, awi l-waladayn
dialogue.en: The big family disappeared and the small family appeared, which includes the husband, the wife and a child or two.
dialogue.ur: Bara khandan khatam hua aur chhota khandan samne aaya jis mein shauhar, biwi aur ek ya do bachche hote hain.

dialogue.ar: ضَعُفَتِ العَلاقَةُ بَيْنَ أَفْرادِ الأُسْرَةِ، فَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ الآباءُ يَقْضُونَ مُعْظَمَ الوَقْتِ فِي أَماكِنِ العَمَلِ.
dialogue.tr: ḍaʿufati l-ʿalāqatu bayna afrādi l-usrah, faqad aṣbaḥa l-ābāʾu yaqḍūna muʿẓama l-waqti fī amākini l-ʿamal
dialogue.en: The relationship between family members weakened, as fathers now spend most of their time at work.
dialogue.ur: Afraad ke darmiyan taalluq kamzor hua kyunke walid zyada waqt kaam par guzarte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يَرَوْنَ أَطْفالَهُمْ إِلاّ قَلِيلًا؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ فِي الصَّباحِ وَيَتْرُكُونَهُمْ نائِمِينَ، وَيَرْجِعُونَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَيَجِدُونَهُمْ نائِمِينَ.
dialogue.tr: wa lā yarawna aṭfālahum illā qalīlā; li-annahum yakhrujūna fiṣ-ṣabāḥ wa yatrukūnahum nāʾimīn, wa yarjiʿūna fil-layl wa yajidūnahum nāʾimīn
dialogue.en: They see their children only a little, because they leave in the morning while the children sleep and return at night and find them asleep.
dialogue.ur: Wo apne bachon ko kam hi dekhte hain kyunke subah nikalte hain jab bachche soye hote hain aur raat ko aate hain to bachche phir soye mile.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ ناحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى، يُغادِرُ الأَوْلادُ البَيْتَ فِي الصَّباحِ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، وَيَرْجِعُونَ فِي المَساءِ، فَتَبْقَى الأُمُّ فِي البَيْتِ وَحْدَها مُعْظَمَ الوَقْتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa min nāḥiyatin ukhrā, yughādiru l-awlādu l-bayta fiṣ-ṣabāḥi ilā l-madrasah, wa yarjiʿūna fil-masāʾ, fatabqā l-ummu fil-bayti waḥdahā muʿẓama l-waqt
dialogue.en: On the other hand, the children leave home in the morning for school and return in the evening, so the mother stays alone at home most of the time.
dialogue.ur: Dusri taraf bachche subah school jate aur shaam ko aate hain, to maan zyada waqt ghar mein akeli rehti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ صُوَرِ الاخْتِلافِ أَيْضًا، خُرُوجُ بَعْضِ النِّساءِ مِنَ البَيْتِ إِلَى العَمَلِ.
dialogue.tr: wa min ṣuwari l-ikhtilāfi ayḍan, khurūju baʿḍi n-nisāʾi mina l-bayti ilā l-ʿamal
dialogue.en: Another form of the difference is that some women go out of the house to work.
dialogue.ur: Farq ki ek surat ye bhi hai ke kuch auratein ghar se kaam par jati hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعِنْدَما تَرْجِعُ تَكُونُ مُتْعَبَةً، فَلا تَقُومُ بِعَمَلِ البَيْتِ مِنْ نَظافَةٍ وَإِعْدادٍ لِلطَّعامِ، وَلا تَجِدُ وَقْتًا لِتَجْلِسَ مَعَ أَطْفالِها أَوْ زَوْجِها لِلْحَدِيثِ فِي أُمُورِ الأَوْلادِ وَالبَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿindamā tarjiʿu takūnu mutʿabah, falā taqūmu biʿamali l-bayt min naẓāfatin wa iʿdādin liṭ-ṭaʿām, wa lā tajidu waqtan litajlisa maʿa aṭfālihā aw zawjihā lil-ḥadīthi fī umūri l-awlādi wal-bayt
dialogue.en: When she returns she is tired, so she does not do the housework of cleaning and preparing food, and does not find time to sit with her children or husband to talk about the children and the home.
dialogue.ur: Jab wo wapas aati hai to thaki hoti hai, isliye safai aur khana pakane ka kaam nahin kar pati aur bachon ya shauhar ke saath baat karne ka waqt nahin milta.

q.en: In the past, the big family…

q.ur: Chhote khandan mein kaun hota hai?

q.en: Why do fathers see their children only a little?
q.ur: Walid bachon ko kam kyun dekhte hain?
q.ar: لِماذا لا يَرى الآباءُ أَوْلادَهُمْ إِلّا قَليلاً؟

options: They spend most of the time at work

intro.en: A pronoun (ضَمِير) stands in for a noun. It is for the speaker (مُتَكَلِّم), the one spoken to (مُخاطَب) or the one spoken about (غائِب). Example: أَنا (I), أَنْتَ (you, m.), هُوَ (he).
intro.ur: Zameer (ضَمِير) ism ki jagah aata hai. Ye mutakallim (bolne wala), mukhatab (jis se baat ho) ya ghaib (jis ka zikr ho) ke liye hota hai. Misaal: أَنا (main), أَنْتَ (tum, mard), هُوَ (wo, mard).
intro.ar: الضَّميرُ كَلِمَةٌ تَقومُ مَقامَ الاسْمِ. وَهُوَ لِلْمُتَكَلِّمِ أَوْ لِلْمُخاطَبِ أَوْ لِلْغائِبِ. أَمْثِلَةٌ: أَنا، أَنْتَ، هُوَ.

q.ur: «Main» ke liye kaun sa zameer hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمِ المُفْرَدِ؟

q.ur: «Hum» ke liye kaun sa zameer hai?

q.en: Which pronoun is for «you» (to a group of men)?
q.ur: Mardon ke group se «tum» ke liye?

intro.en: Practise writing five sentences about a picture and a short topic about married life or the family. You also learn punctuation marks: the full stop, question mark, exclamation mark, comma, quotation marks and colon.
intro.ur: Tasweer ke baare mein paanch jumle likhne ki mashq aur shadi-shuda zindagi ya khandan par mazmoon. Saath hi alamat-e-tarqeem: full stop, sawaliya nishan, tajjub ka nishan, comma, iqtibas aur colon.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى كِتابَةِ خَمْسِ جُمَلٍ عَنْ صورَةٍ وَمَوْضوعٍ قَصيرٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ أَوِ الأُسْرَةِ. وَتَتَعَلَّمُ عَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ: النُّقْطَةَ، وَالاسْتِفْهامَ، وَالتَّعَجُّبَ، وَالفاصِلَةَ، وَالتَّنْصيصَ، وَالنُّقْطَتَيْنِ.

q.ur: Sawal ke aakhir mein kaun si nishani aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تُوضَعُ في نِهايَةِ السُّؤالِ؟

q.en: Which mark shows surprise (like «يا لَها مِنْ نَصِيحَةٍ!»)?
q.ur: Tajjub kis nishan se zaahir hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الدَّهْشَةِ في «يا لَها مِنْ نَصيحَةٍ!»؟

q.en: A topic from the unit: «الحَياةُ الزَّوْجِيَّةُ» means…

title.en: Calligraphy and dictation: the moving ta

intro.en: Copy a Hadith in Naskh script: «A Muslim may not shun his brother for more than three nights.» Then learn that the moving ta comes in two shapes: the round ta (ـة / ة) and the open ta (ت).
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein ek hadees naql karein: «Kisi Muslim ke liye jaiz nahin ke apne bhai se teen raat se zyada tarke-taalluq rakhe.» Phir seekhein ke ta mutaharrika ki do shakalein hain: gol ta (ـة / ة) aur khuli ta (ت).
intro.ar: اِنْسَخْ حَديثاً بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ: «لا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ». ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ التّاءَ المُتَحَرِّكَةَ لَها شَكْلانِ: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة / ة) وَالتّاءُ المَفْتوحَةُ (ت).

dialogue.ar: لا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ. (حَدِيثٌ شَرِيفٌ)
dialogue.tr: lā yaḥillu limuslimin an yahjura akhāhu fawqa thalāthi layāl
dialogue.en: It is not lawful for a Muslim to shun his brother for more than three nights. (Hadith)
dialogue.ur: Kisi Muslim ke liye jaiz nahin ke apne bhai se teen raat se zyada tarke-taalluq kare. (Hadees)

q.en: What are the two shapes of the moving ta?
Which word ends with the round ta?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke aakhir mein gol ta hai?

q.en: Which word has the open ta (ت)?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein khuli ta (ت) hai?
«طَبِيبات» ki jama kis ta se likhi jati hai?

q.en: What does the Hadith say a Muslim may not do for more than three nights?
q.ur: Hadees ke mutabiq kya teen raat se zyada jaiz nahin?
q.ar: ماذا لا يَحِلُّ لِلْمُسْلِمِ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ فَوْقَ ثَلاثِ لَيالٍ بِحَسَبِ الحَديثِ؟
